name: Fitnation Gym
address: Sheikh Ammar Bin Humaid St - Al Rawda 2 - Ajman - United Arab Emirates
owner_description: At Fitnation, we are dedicated to helping you achieve your fitness goals through a comprehensive approach to health and wellness. Our state-of-the-art facility is equipped with top-of-the-line bodybuilding machines, designed to support all fitness levels. We offer personalized training with experienced personal trainers who tailor workouts to your individual needs. Whether you're looking to build muscle, increase stamina, or improve overall health, Fitnation has everything you need. Our diverse range of classes, including boxing, strength training, and more, are all included in your membership, providing a full-body workout experience in a motivating and supportive environment. Join Fitnation to take the next step in your fitness journey!

reviews.author: Falah hack vloge
reviews.text:
I’ve had a really great experience at Fitnation Gym, and I honestly want to appreciate the entire team for their excellent work and professionalism. The gym has a very positive atmosphere, with good equipment, a clean environment, and everything you need to stay motivated and consistent with your fitness goals.

I would especially like to appreciate the manager for the outstanding work and dedication. A good gym is not only about having equipment — it’s also about having good management and people who genuinely care about their members. The manager is professional, respectful, friendly, and always willing to help. You can clearly see the effort being put into making sure everything runs smoothly and members are happy.

I really appreciate how the manager treats everyone with respect and creates a welcoming environment for both new and regular members. The way the gym is managed shows real dedication and hard work. It’s not easy to maintain a gym at a high standard, but the team at Fitnation is doing a great job.

reviews.author: ASHRAF KHAN
reviews.text:
Great gym with a friendly and supportive team! I’ve been a member of Fitnation Gym Ajman for over a year and have really noticed the positive changes recently. The management’s efforts are clearly making a difference, with more coaches and an overall better experience.

Senior Coach and Manager is definitely someone to look out for—professional, approachable, and always helpful. The team is friendly and supportive, and Boxing Coach Eric is excellent at what he does, especially when it comes to training and technique.

Overall, a great place to train. Highly recommended! 💪🥊

reviews.author: Danyal Ahmadzai
reviews.text: I really enjoy going to my gym because it is a clean, friendly, and motivating place. The manager is kind, helpful, and always makes sure everyone feels welcome. He takes good care of the gym and encourages people to work hard. Overall, I am happy to be a member there.

reviews.author: حمود 69
reviews.text: I was pleased to meet the manager, Captain Arshad, today. He was very helpful regarding an issue I faced due to performing an exercise incorrectly on my own; he guided me through exercises that helped relieve the pain. I extend my sincere thanks to him for his boundless cooperation with everyone at the club, and I wish him continued success and prosperity.🤍🤍

reviews.author: محمد احمد
reviews.text:
This was by far one of the worst gym experiences I’ve ever had, and the main reason was not the equipment or the facilities—it was the management. The manager has an arrogant attitude toward customers, treating them as if they don’t deserve basic respect or appreciation, despite the fact that they are paying for the service. I also witnessed the way he treated the trainers in front of others, and it was unprofessional and disrespectful, creating a negative atmosphere throughout the gym.

Respect is the minimum any customer should expect, but unfortunately, I did not find it here. No matter how good the equipment or facilities are, poor management and disrespectful behavior ruin the entire experience. I sincerely hope the owners take this issue seriously and review the manager’s conduct, because if this continues, many customers will think twice before coming back.

reviews.author: Mousa Aldabyanj
reviews.text: I’d like to thank Coach Nofal. In a short time, I noticed a big improvement in my training. He corrected my exercises and helped me overcome a forearm issue with some helpful exercises. I really appreciate his support.

reviews.author: Mohammad Javeed
reviews.text:
A big thank you to Coach Noufal for the wonderful stretching session yesterday. I was struggling with severe lower back pain and was barely able to walk. After the stretches, I’m now able to walk with bear minimal pain.

Your knowledge, care, and guidance made a real difference. Truly grateful, Coach Noufal! 🙏👏
